_comment: Real-bottle portraits for My Bar, generated into public/bottles/b/<slug>.webp — the file name is the pool slug of `name` (poolKey.mjs rules), and that slug is what the app looks up at runtime, so `name` is the contract. `category` is the bottle's family (for the prompt and for matching BOTTLE_TYPES), `hint` steers the look when the brand's bottle is distinctive. Aliases for alternative shelf spellings live in src/domain/bottleVisual.ts (ALIASES). Run: GOOGLE_API_KEY=... node scripts/make-bottle-images.mjs --bottles
